description: Refresh the org repo index now instead of waiting for the nightly sweep. Re-lists every repo's metadata AND auto-detects COMMITTED coverage: for repos with no crew/CI coverage, it reads the repo tree for a checked-in coverage report (lcov.info, coverage-summary.json, cobertura, clover) and records the parsed %, so a repo that publishes coverage in git shows a number without a crew run or a manual upload. Runs in the background — re-read the repo index / coverage panel shortly after. Requires `write` scope.
name: anyforge_refresh_repo_index
title: Refresh repo index
